content: {"episode_id":"ep-05029","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction. Given concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology contributing to these symptoms, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant rhythm disturbances."}
